issues.problem: cl-take contrast 撮る/取る claimed 'everything else is 取る', false (採る, 捕る, 執る share the reading).
issues.action: Restricted to: picking up, getting and keeping take 取る.

issues.problem: cl-take tip ('does your hand end up holding it') would wrongly exclude 休みを取る, 百点を取る, which explain teaches as 取る.
issues.action: Reworded the test to 'do I end up having it (the salt, a day off, a score)?'.

issues.problem: cl-weather rule said 'always ... and が'; は/も also mark these subjects (雨は降らない), and 晴れる has no noun.
issues.action: Changed to 'with the weather word as the subject'.

issues.problem: cl-weather explain called 曇る 'clear weather'.
issues.action: Changed to 'Clearing up and clouding over are verbs on their own: 晴れる, 曇る'.

issues.problem: cl-life example 金曜日の夜、レストランに予約を入れました reads as booking made on Friday night, not 'for Friday night'; レストランに予約 also less natural than レストランの予約.
issues.action: Replaced with 電話で、レストランの予約を入れました / 'I booked a restaurant by phone.'

issues.problem: cl-life contrast '入れる / 取る' said 'do not swap them', contradicting explain, which correctly allows 予約を取る.
issues.action: Replaced with contrast '取る / 持つ': 年を取る, 休みを取る; 年を持つ and 休みを持つ are wrong.

issues.problem: cl-life explain presented 学校を出る as only 'graduate'; it can also mean physically leaving the building.
issues.action: Added the caveat that context decides.
